subject: Evidence request — VM cadence, rollback cert, CVE-2026-1890 artifacts
messages:
From: Karen Lin <karen.lin@clearpulse.com>

Date: 2026-06-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Evidence request — VM cadence, rollback cert, CVE-2026-1890 artifacts

Hi Rishi / Laura,

Thanks for the quick responses earlier this week. As part of our SIG/SOC2 intake for ClearPulse we need to collect vulnerability management evidence covering your scan cadence, SLA commitments for CVE remediation, and proof of post-patch validation (including rollback confirmations if applicable). Specifics we need by COB 2026-06-08: 

1) Scan cadence summary (tools used, last full host and container scan dates, frequency).
2) A sample remediation log for a recently closed medium/high CVE — ideally CVE-2026-1890 if you have it in the window — showing discovery date, owner, remediation plan, and closure timestamp.
3) A short attestation letter signed by an engineering/security lead confirming your SLA targets for critical/important vulnerabilities and your rollback policy.
4) Evidence of post-patch validation for the provided CVE (test run output, verification CSV) and a note if any rollback was required.

If any of this requires an NDA or a separate channel, tell me and we can arrange it. We can accept redacted artifacts if needed, but timelines are tight.

Thanks,
Karen Lin
Senior Security Manager, ClearPulse
security@clearpulse.com

--
Requested attachments: none attached in this email (see list above).

Date: 2026-06-02T11:03:00-07:00

Karen,

Appreciate the clear list. We're attaching a first-pass bundle and can provide redacted or full artifacts depending on your preference. Summary below and next steps.

Summary of what I attached:
- redwood_vm_index_20260601.csv: scan cadence matrix (host/container), last full host scan 2026-05-28, container scans daily, primary scanner: Trivy + commercial scheduler.
- cve-2026-1890-remediation-log.csv: cleanup log for CVE-2026-1890 showing discovery, owner, patch rollout, and closure stamps.

Proposed attestation wording (please confirm):
"Redwood Inference confirms that Critical vulnerabilities are targeted for remediation within 7 calendar days from detection where a validated patch or mitigation exists; High (Important) vulnerabilities are targeted within 30 calendar days. Post-patch validation is performed for all production-impacting remediations and documented in internal validation artifacts. Rollbacks are supported when post-deployment validation fails; rollback windows and criteria are described in the attached remediation log."

We can sign a formal attestation PDF once wording is agreed. Grace will run a post-patch validation sweep on 2026-06-04 and produce the CSV output you requested. Laura is looping Marcus for SLA confirmation and final sign-off.

Attachments included: redwood_vm_index_20260601.csv, cve-2026-1890-remediation-log.csv

Let me know if you want additional telemetry (e.g., patch diffs or process runbooks).

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Customer Security Programs
Redwood Inference

Karen asked for artifacts by COB 2026-06-08; let's aim to deliver the formal attestation and the validation CSV by EOD 2026-06-05 so they have time to intake. Rishi — keep me on the thread with the final PDF before sending.

Karen,

Apologies for the delay — attaching the formal attestation and the post-patch validation export from Grace's run. Key points are below and included verbatim in the attached PDF (vm-attestation-clearpulse-20260605.pdf).

Attestation (excerpt):
"Redwood Inference attests that for the period covering 2026-01-01 through 2026-05-31: Critical severity vulnerabilities are remediated within a target SLA of 7 calendar days from confirmed detection when a vendor or internal patch/mitigation is available. High (Important) severity vulnerabilities are remediated within a target SLA of 30 calendar days. Post-patch validation is conducted for all production-impacting remediations; validation artifacts are retained for 12 months. Rollbacks are performed when post-deployment validations indicate functional regressions or security degradations; rollback procedures are documented and tracked in remediation logs. This attestation is issued by Redwood Inference and signed by the undersigned"

Post-patch validation summary:
- Validation run date: 2026-06-04
- Hosts validated: 12 production hosts (IDs redacted in CSV)
- Test cases: smoke checks, service health probes, regression unit checks
- Results: 11 passed, 1 failed -> rollback executed on host app-prod-07; rollback timestamp and notes included in postpatch-validation-20260604.csv

Attachments: vm-attestation-clearpulse-20260605.pdf (signed), postpatch-validation-20260604.csv

If you need signatures on a separate letterhead or notarized documentation for compliance, let us know and we can route to Legal.

Thanks for the patience,
Marcus Lin
VP, Infrastructure Reliability
Redwood Inference
